limitations: Same composition and site counts, volume/atom within 1%, positive saved StructureMatcher, unchanged run type/nonzero U. Untested structure matches are excluded, making this stricter than the published support counts. The saved matcher uses scale=True and finite tolerances; structural equivalence is not proof of identical coordinates or zero geometry-related energy error.
Alexandria source POTCAR/U metadata are absent in the saved matches; legacy scale is an external-check assumption, not a verified per-entry hash identity.
Inconclusive probes with legacy point preference retain target legacy; this is not decisive scale evidence. Elements without a supporting probe retain the existing legacy target by policy.
method: Independent unweighted no-intercept Huber fits of raw delta E/atom on hash-specific changed-element fractions. Threshold 1.345 * max(0.001, 1.4826 * OLS residual MAD). IRLS to 1e-9; chemical-system cluster bootstrap, percentile CI, threshold fixed within each bootstrap. 70/30 system-disjoint validation fits only training data. Unique sample-cohort Alexandria matches only; no population reweighting. MP estimates applied at n_mp >= 50, or n_mp >= 20 with overlapping MP/Alexandria 95% CIs, including near-zero values. Target legacy follows a legacy probe verdict or an inconclusive verdict with legacy point preference; unprobed elements retain the existing legacy target by policy. Applied elements with any new-scale verdict or point preference raise an error for a manual decision. Probe results are copied verbatim with the source summary SHA-256; their asset_shift and comparison refer to the probe-time asset.
sign: s = E(new file) - E(legacy file), eV per atom of the element

validation.split: 70/30 by chemical system; training-only fit and Huber scale
